footer.about: WISECOM Global Trading and Supplies is your trusted partner for quality electronics, home essentials, and mobility solutions, new and used, between Douala and Yaounde.

about.title: About WISECOM
about.intro: WISECOM Global Trading and Supplies is your trusted partner for quality electronics, home essentials, and mobility solutions. Founded by Atanga Randi, WISECOM specializes in both new and fairly used laptops, phones, accessories, computer parts, home appliances, and even motorcycles and selected vehicles. With our head office in Douala and a branch office in Yaounde, we are dedicated to providing reliable products, fair prices, and excellent customer service.
about.missionText: To enhance everyday life by offering quality products and dependable trading solutions.
about.visionText: To become one of Africa's leading trading companies, recognized for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
about.ceoRole: Founder, WISECOM Global Trading and Supplies
about.ceoQuote: As the founder of WISECOM, my goal is to build a trusted company that delivers quality products at fair prices, while creating long-term value for our customers and business partners. Every product we offer reflects our commitment to excellence and reliability.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Sales, repair and professional maintenance, across Cameroon
services.intro: At WISECOM Global Trading and Supplies, we are committed to providing high-quality electronic products and professional technical services to individuals, businesses, schools, and organizations across Cameroon.
services.salesText: Genuine new and quality fairly used laptops, desktops, phones, tablets, and accessories.
services.repairText: Our experienced technicians repair and maintain laptops and computers from all major brands. Phone repairs, software installations, system updates, and technical support.
services.maintenanceText: Professional cleaning, performance optimization, virus removal, and preventive care.
services.remoteText: You can visit us or request technical support for home or office. You can also send devices to us for repair, and we return them once serviced.
services.warrantyNote: All eligible products and repairs come with a warranty, because customer satisfaction is our top priority.
services.visionText: Our vision is to become Cameroon's most trusted and respected electronics sales and service company, where quality and innovation meet, and where distance is never a barrier.

warranty.title: Warranty & returns
warranty.subtitle: Your satisfaction is our commitment
warranty.intro: We test each device before handover. All eligible products and repairs come with an official invoice and warranty receipt that states the terms and warranty period.
warranty.coverageText: Our warranty covers manufacturing faults and parts replaced by WISECOM.
warranty.durationPhones: The stated period for phones on your receipt
warranty.exclusionsText: Damage from accidents, liquids, power surges, misuse, or third-party repairs is not covered. After the warranty period, further work can be done as a new service.
warranty.returnText: Customers across Cameroon can conveniently send devices to us for repair, and we return them safely once serviced.
warranty.closing: We build relationships, not just sales, through quality products, professional service, and clear warranty protection.

importExport.title: Import & Export
importExport.subtitle: Reliable global sourcing, secure shipping, fast local delivery
importExport.intro: At WISECOM Global Trading and Supplies, logistics is at the heart of what we do. We provide complete procurement, international shipping, and local delivery services, ensuring every order reaches our customers safely and efficiently.
importExport.sourcingText: We source high quality products from trusted suppliers in Dubai, China, and the United States, giving our customers access to both genuine new and fairly used products.
importExport.airFreightText: For fast deliveries, our air freight service typically takes around ten days to Cameroon, depending on flight schedules and customs.
importExport.seaFreightText: For larger or more economical shipments, our sea freight option takes approximately two months depending on schedules.
importExport.deliveryText: Once your shipment arrives in Cameroon, our delivery team ensures prompt distribution to your home, office, or business.
importExport.closing: At WISECOM, we believe logistics is more than transportation. It's about reliability, trust, and customer satisfaction.

vehicles.title: Motorbikes & vehicles
vehicles.subtitle: Quality mobility, new and used
vehicles.intro: Alongside our electronics offering, WISECOM provides selected motorcycles and vehicles, new and fairly used, with the same commitment to quality, fair prices, and customer service that defines our company.
